# Make editor schemas

Copied unchanged from [integromat/make-apps-skill](https://github.com/integromat/make-apps-skill/tree/522944f7e511a92c4bf2dcf7469bc21272e01260/skills/make-custom-apps/references/editor-schemas), commit `522944f7e511a92c4bf2dcf7469bc21272e01260`. See LICENSE.md.

These schemas derive from the Make Apps Editor and include documented vendor corrections. They validate section structure, not IML evaluation or API behavior. Update all JSON files and the license together, rerun the local build/tests, and review schema changes before updating this pin.
